polls.pollster: Stetson University Center for Public Opinion Research
polls.sponsor: Stetson CPOR publication; outside sponsor not stated
polls.population: Registered voters, weighted by modeled likelihood of voting (826 adults interviewed)
polls.method: Qualtrics opt-in online panel; demographic weights and 2024 vote calibration. Includes leaners; precision estimate is not a random-sample margin of error.
